notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls an enchantment.
description:
Cast Role Reversal by paying {U}{U}{R}, exchanging control of an enchantment an opponent controls and Nefarious Lich.
Activate Staff of Compleation's first ability by tapping it and paying 1 life, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.
